select t.talk_id as talkId,t.status,u.user_name as nickName,u.avatar as imageUrl,t.is_delete as isDelete,t.audit_content as auditContent, t.create_time as createTime,t.content,t.img,t.share_num as shareNum,t.user_id as userId,t.video_url as videoUrl, (select count(*) from comment c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id) as commentCount, (select count(*) from talk_reward c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id and c.user_id=#{byUserId}) as rewardByUserCount, (select count(*) from talk_reward c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id) as rewardCount, (select count(*) from comment c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id and c.user_id=#{byUserId}) as commentByUserCount, (select count(*) from good_talk c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id and c.user_id=#{byUserId}) as goodTalkByUserCount, (select count(*) from user_follow f where f.user_id=#{byUserId} and f.follow_user_id=t.user_id) as followedCount, (select count(*) from good_talk c where c.talk_id=t.talk_id) as goodTalkCount from talk t left join tb_user u on u.user_id=t.user_id where 1=1
and t.status=#{status}
and t.status=2
and u.user_id in (select follow_user_id from user_follow where user_id=#{followUserId})
and t.user_id=#{userId}
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{nickName},'%')
and t.content like concat('%',#{content},'%')
and t.video_url is not null and t.video_url!=''
and t.is_delete is null
order by t.create_time desc

select c.content,ifnull(u.user_name,'神秘用户') as nickName,u.avatar as imageUrl,c.create_time as createTime,c.comment_id as commentId, u.phone from comment c left join tb_user u on u.user_id=c.user_id where parent_id=0
and c.user_id=#{userId}
and c.talk_id=#{talkId}
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and u.phone like concat('%',#{phone},'%')
and c.content like concat('%',#{content},'%')
order by c.create_time desc
